shortDescription: Elon Musk said chipmaker Nvidia NASDAQ:NVDA would lose "critical" deals without its now ousted CEO Jensen Huang, in a post on X on Saturday.Musk said that while Huang drove supply chain "brilliantly" at Nvidia, many such deals were "a handshake with Jensen, not a written contract."
